sheets.hero_sheet.actions.title: ⚔️ ATTACKS & COMBAT ACTIONS
sheets.hero_sheet.actions.std_body:
• Attack: Make a melee or ranged weapon attack.
• Dash: Double your movement speed this turn.
• Disengage: Your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
• Dodge: Attacks against you have disadvantage and you have advantage on DEX saves.
• Help: Grant advantage to an ally on their next check or attack.
• Hide: Make a Stealth check to conceal yourself.
• Utilize / Use Object: Drink a potion, interact with the environment, or activate an item.
